ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-intensity (white/light grey) pixels dominate approximately 85-90% of the visible surface area, contrasted with low-intensity (black/dark grey) pixels primarily along the trailing edge and distal tips.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant light field (high intensity) across both lobes; continuous dark-band margin along the trailing edge. Multiple discrete dark focal blobs (low intensity) located at approx. center-low near notch, mid-right lobe, and lower-left lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep, acute V-shaped depression with an estimated angle of 45-50 degrees and significant pixel depth relative to the horizontal axis of the lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, high-amplitude serrations concentrated at the distal tips; moderate-frequency, low-amplitude undulating peaks along the central trailing edge boundary.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave sweep from the median notch extending towards the tips, with a convex curvature on the leading edges of the lobes.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Distinct cluster of approximately 4 dark circular pixel groupings located immediately superior to the median notch; individual dark spots visible on the right mid-lobe and left lower-lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Faint, low-contrast grey linear streaks oriented diagonally on the medial portion of the left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extreme irregular contouring and apparent tissue loss at both the left and right fluke tips, resulting in a highly jagged, torn appearance.
